task.title: e2e catalog fixture pool: stop tests draining the unowned-card supply
task.description: Filed from P6-189 (2026-08-10). The e2e helpers derive 'a card the user does not own' from /api/catalog search + /api/all-cards with a fixed limit (60 in needs.spec.ts/removal.spec.ts, 200 in collection-tree-manage.spec.ts after P6-189 widened it as insurance). Repeated local iteration drains the pool: delete's ToParent default relocates cards instead of freeing ownership, so the dev user's owned set grows monotonically and once it exceeds the query cap the helpers can return an owned card — assertions like copiesIn(...).toBe(1) then go WRONG rather than failing loudly. Fix properly: either a periodic reset mechanism for the e2e user's collection on dev, or derive unowned cards by exclusion against the FULL owned set (paginate), and assert the precondition loudly in the helper. Specs: e2e-suite skill conventions.
